# Documentation conventions (`doc/`)

The docs site publishes `doc/` verbatim at each release tag and embeds gallery pages from `example/lib/pages/` through `<x-preview>` tags. The site validates almost nothing, so a typo ships as a dead link or an empty frame; `tool/check-docs.py` is the only gate.

## File shape

```markdown
# WFoo

One-line description of what the widget or concept does.

- [Basic Usage](#basic-usage)
- [Related Documentation](#related-documentation)

<x-preview path="widgets/w_foo_basic" size="md" source="example/lib/pages/widgets/w_foo_basic.dart"></x-preview>

<a name="basic-usage"></a>
## Basic Usage

<a name="related-documentation"></a>
## Related Documentation

- [WAnchor](../widgets/w-anchor.md): auto-wraps when className contains state prefixes.
```

## Rules

- Every page sits at `doc/<section>/<page>.md` with a lowercase kebab-case name, and its `#` title is the file's first line: no lead paragraph or code fence above it. Never skip a heading level.
- Put `<a name="kebab-slug"></a>` immediately before every `##` and list each slug in the ToC above the first anchor; the checker rejects an anchor the ToC does not reach.
- `<x-preview>`: `source` is the repo-root path of the example page, and `path` is that path minus `example/lib/pages/` and `.dart`. `path` must be a route key in `example/lib/routes.dart`, because the iframe URL is the preview base plus `path`. An empty `path=""` is the demo's `/` route and is valid. Add or extend the example page in the same change.
- Widget pages carry Basic Usage, Constructor (the full signature), Props and Related Documentation. A Props table has left-aligned columns (`:-----`), every identifier in backticks, and `**Required**` in the Default column for a required prop.
- Link with relative `.md` paths inside `doc/` only: a target outside `doc/` is never published. A fragment resolves against an explicit anchor or the heading slug, where punctuation drops and each space becomes one hyphen (`## Date + Time Selection` is `#date--time-selection`).
- Editing an existing page: keep the structure of sections you are not changing, and match the neighbouring section's style for a new one.

## What never goes in `doc/`

API reference dumps (dartdoc), changelog entries (`CHANGELOG.md`), marketing copy (`README.md`) and internal architecture (`ARCHITECTURE.md`).
